# tomswallapi_nat (Resource)

A one-to-one static NAT bound to the device that owns the external IP.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_nat" "web" {
  device    = "fw1"
  external  = "203.0.113.10"
  internal  = "192.0.2.10"
  interface = "eth0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device` (String) Device that holds the external address.
- `external` (String) External IP address.
- `internal` (String) Internal IP address.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `interface` (String) Interface that has the external address.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Server-assigned id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the server-assigned numeric id.
terraform import tomswallapi_nat.web 42
```
